narrative.overview: The interface is a calm, exact record book kept on a busy ward. Warm paper surfaces, ink-dark numbers and a single forest green carry the identity. Colour is reserved for stock status, so when red or amber appears it is the most important thing on screen. The system is quiet until something needs attention. It never decorates to fill space.
keyCharacteristics: Warm paper canvas, white hairline cards, forest-green sidebar and primary actions.
Status colour (red / amber / green / grey) is the only saturated colour, and it is always paired with a text label.
Flat surfaces; shadows only on things that float.
One card radius, one control radius, pills for status and filters.
Numbers are the product: large, light, tabular.

rules.name: The Status-Only Colour Rule
rules.body: Saturated colour means stock or workflow status, and nothing else.

rules.name: The Label-Always Rule
rules.body: No status is communicated by hue alone.

rules.name: The One Vocabulary Rule
rules.body: Status colours come from src/lib/status.js; pages never pick them.

rules.name: The Tabular Rule
rules.body: Every quantity, count or date uses tabular-nums.

rules.name: The Two-Weight Rule
rules.body: At most 400 and 600 at body size; no bold.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: A surface gets a hairline border or a shadow, never both.

dos: Do route every colour through the tokens; never use hex values or Tailwind palette colours in pages.
Do use statusConfig() and StatusBadge for stock status, and the shared request-status config for workflow status.
Do use the shared components instead of hand-rolling them.
Do keep one primary action per region and put page actions in the PageHeader actions slot.
Do pair every status colour with its text label.
Do use tabular-nums for every number.
donts: Don't use coloured left-border stripes on cards or rows.
Don't put an icon tile in the corner of every KPI card.
Don't use ring gauges or donuts as decoration.
Don't stack border, shadow and radius on resting cards.
Don't mix radii for the same kind of container.
Don't use emoji or glyph characters as icons.
Don't use gradients, glassmorphism or backdrop-blur surfaces.
Don't use bold (700+) or oversized greetings on work screens.
